description: This file contains a Smarty plugin function for generating various HTML buttons used within the SuiteCRM framework, notably in forms and subpanels. It handles different button types like Save, Cancel, Delete, Duplicate, and others, including special functions like viewing change logs through popups. The code dynamically constructs button HTML with embedded JavaScript for form handling and integrates with SuiteCRM's AJAX UI framework. It also supports custom and HTML snippets, allowing flexible button rendering based on metadata configurations.

methods.name: smarty_function_sugar_button
methods.description: Main function that generates HTML for various SuiteCRM buttons based on parameters, including handling different button types, custom code, and HTML snippets. It uses JavaScript embedded in the buttons for form submission and navigation, supports appending output to Smarty templates, and handles popup and subpanel buttons, among others.

methods.name: replaceFormClick
methods.description: Recursively processes a parsed HTML DOM array to replace form-related event handlers, fixing JavaScript code for form submission, and indicating if hidden inputs are present.

methods.name: extractHiddenInputs
methods.description: Traverses a parsed HTML DOM array to extract hidden input fields, especially when processing custom HTML code, ensuring they are correctly attached to the form.
